# ASTER DA MASTER

> The official catalogue of the underground artist **Aster da Master** (digicore/hyperpop orbit, scene tag "somelowlifes"). A calm, minimal site over a deep data archive. Catalog: **221** transmissions total  —  **36** distributor releases (9 albums, 27 singles, verified via Apple Music/iTunes Search API, both distributor profiles) + **185** SoundCloud-only tracks (read-only capture 2026-10-11, play counts are a snapshot).

Method: titles and metadata only  —  no lyrics ever, no invented biography. Unknowns are listed as unknowns (see the press kit's verified-facts register). Play counts are a 2026-10-11 snapshot held in the data layer; since the 2026-10-15 sleek-minimal rework they are not shown anywhere on the presented site. Upload dates are not recording dates. Data version: 0.19.0.

Generators: `scripts/build_*.py` rebuild the catalogue and the data layer from `data/artist.json`; dependency order: releases → years → circle → codex → sessions → milestones → milestone_watch → firstlast → search_index → changelog → transmission → network → eras → session_clusters → codex_pages → milestone_races → session_tools → codex_network → producer_deepdives → chronicle. Re-running sets data version in all JSON.

Repo: private GitHub-only (astercast/aster-da-master), no Vercel. Deploy: any static host serving the repo root.

## The site (sleek-minimal rework, 2026-10-15)

Four doors over a home page. Everything else the archive knows lives in the data layer below, unchanged.

- [Home](index.html): the artist's name, the official SoundCloud player, the latest release and the newest six, and the six eras.
- [Releases](releases/): the complete catalogue  —  **221** transmissions (185 SoundCloud-only tracks + 36 distributor releases), one quiet list with title search and year/type filters; every release keeps its own page (cover, credits as titled, platform links, provenance).
- [Story](story.html): the career in six eras, 2017 to today, told from the record.
- [About](about.html): who he is, the facts on record, and where to listen (the **22** title-credited collaborators and the **16** codex vocabulary families live in the data layer now).
- [Press kit](press-kit.html): the press kit  —  facts as recorded, unknowns stated as unknowns.
- [Not in the catalogue (404)](404.html): the 404 page.

The data layer keeps the full archive: **64** upload sessions, **113** as-credited producers, **15** agent skills, and every endpoint below, exactly as before the rework.

## Data endpoints

All data lives as static JSON at `data/v1/*.json` — no auth. The self-describing registry is [the API index](data/v1/index.json): every endpoint with description, schema URL (`data/v1/schema/*.json`, all 23 validating), `updated` timestamp, record counts, and deprecation notes.

- [artist](data/v1/artist.json): the canonical artist record — bio, facts, discography, platforms, socials.
- [circle](data/v1/circle.json): the 22 title-credited collaborators and their shared records.
- [scene-figures](data/v1/scene-figures.json): documented producer/scene figures beyond the circle's title-credit rule.
- [codex](data/v1/codex.json): the 16 codex vocabulary families.
- [codex-families](data/v1/codex-families.json): codex family deep-dives — decoded readings, era evolution, key sessions, collaborators; drives the codex pages.
- [codex-network](data/v1/codex-network.json): the codex network graph — families, shared voices and producers as edges, degrees of separation.
- [years](data/v1/years.json): the catalog grouped by year.
- [eras](data/v1/eras.json): era deep-dives — full transmission lists, all in-era collaborators, active codex families, computed signal summaries.
- [transmission](data/v1/transmission.json): six era aggregates for the guided journey; the 2026 era carries an `extras` block (the four verified 2026 singles, the Q4 2026 Uncle-LP/trilogy watch, the play-count snapshot).
- [network](data/v1/network.json): the collaboration graph — nodes, edges, insights.
- [producer-deepdives](data/v1/producer-deepdives.json): the 113 as-credited producers and their deep-dive data.
- [sessions](data/v1/sessions.json): the 64 upload sessions clustered by date.
- [session-clusters](data/v1/session-clusters.json): session archaeology — 64 enriched sessions, 63 gaps, 9 activity seasons, asserted insights; drives the sessions explorer.
- [session-tools](data/v1/session-tools.json): session explorer 2.0 — 64 compare profiles, deepest-sessions editorial ranking, the track-level deepest-transmissions ranking (quietest 25 of 185), snapshot-history state.
- [milestones](data/v1/milestones.json): the dated milestones on record.
- [milestone-watch](data/v1/milestone-watch.json): the milestone watch board.
- [milestone-races](data/v1/milestone-races.json): the milestone race 2.0 — approaching races ranked by gap-closing proximity, the vault pace database, The Climb, race history (dated crossings, 1k/10k/20k/30k threshold winners, the 115-day photo finish), the computed race of the week, the summit chase. The 2026-10-11 snapshot was independently re-captured (185/185, zero differences).
- [chronicle](data/v1/chronicle.json): The Chronicle — 114 merged chronological events with era assignment and cross-links; drives the Chronicle page.
- [signal-watch](data/v1/signal-watch.json): The Signal 2.0 watch file — capture-vs-capture diff of the vault (new uploads, play-count movers, milestone crossings, next-up board); written by the daily Signal cron; drives the Signal page.
- [live-dates](data/v1/live-dates.json): the live-date verification board — scene events hand-checked against the web (Fish Narc *Uncle* release week, capoxxo's Oct 28–29 support dates), each verified / single-source / unconfirmed, with sources and discrepancies on record.
- [release-slugs](data/v1/release-slugs.json): the release-page slug registry for all 221 transmissions.
- [on-this-day](data/v1/on-this-day.json): archive events on this day of the year.
- [first-last](data/v1/first-last.json): the archive's firsts and lasts.
- [changelog](data/v1/changelog.json): the construction history, generated from the site's own git log.

## For agents

- [Agent manual](AGENT.md): the operator's manual — base URL pattern, key endpoints with example requests, 7 end-to-end workflows (SomeLowLifes era brief, 10 quietest deep cuts, Max Ferrari collab trace, era deep dive, sessions timeline, codex family trace, milestone race).
- [Agentic surface](agents.html): the full agentic surface — 22-endpoint table, llms files, skills, search-index usage, rate/expectation notes, 5 worked writeups.
- [API playground](api-playground.html): an Explore tab (live endpoint responses) and a Skill recipes tab.
- [Skills registry](skills/index.json): the **15** archive-analysis skill playbooks (Use when / Inputs / Procedure / Worked example / API references / Pitfalls) — deep-cuts-finder, session-archaeology, session-explorer, collaborator-tracer, network-graph-reader, milestone-watcher, era-briefing, transmission-decoder, codex-reader, milestone-race-reader, session-compare, codex-pathfinder, announce-release, build-press-kit, verify-platform-links.

Rules for agents: static JSON, no auth; play counts are a 2026-10-11 snapshot (always state the date); upload dates ≠ recording dates; titles/metadata only, never lyrics, never invent bio facts.

## Key research facts

Key research facts (2026-10-11 pass, sources cited on-site). Earliest indexed track "Protections" (Dec 23, 2019, label "WoT", on album *Master Key*); albums *Cast It:, Pt. 1* (2021), *Cast It:, Pt. 2* (2022); single "Reachhh" (Apr 8, 2024, label "somelowlifes"); 2026 singles "The Night Ends Yeaaa" (Mar), "Writing Books" / "9 Trips" / "Living With The Big Shots" (May).

capoxxo: named in Pitchfork's "A Deeply Incomplete Canon of Hyperpop-Digicore"; collab tape *Persona* w/ mayh3mp (Cult Love Sound Tapes, 2022); tracks "candy", "getting colder". pvscale: produced "fly like me"; co-produced "getting colder" w/ asa41 (further productions attributed by a single catalog-mirror source, unverified — treat as a lead only). Fish Narc (b. 1992, Seattle/Olympia; GothBoiClique; produced Lil Peep's *Goth Angel Sinner*; *frog song* LP 2025, K Records) — producer credit on "Pavement" and "Soul Shaking".

Best SomeLowLifes network evidence: May 15, 2020 Internet Phantoms podcast episode (2 unnamed members; playlist links Lil' Spursy, DirtyDoves, Offline HP, Aster Da Master, producer Lil' Flower) — evidence, not roster. Could not be verified: SomeLowLifes member roster; "litemode / nitemode" meaning; public profiles for Max Ferrari, Yung Vetta, Lil Yu, JAX, YungSkah, AWFL, shinju, odece, lil biscuit, wetgropes, Born Hero.
